nina-dx: running samplekit onboarding, hit unexpected behavior: tool/fncall schema enforcement present on first attempt but dropped after an auth retry.

sam-sdk: can you paste repro?

nina-dx: minimal: SDK constructed with jsonMode:true and strictSchema:true. first call rejects extra fields. simulate 401 -> SDK retry path recreates helper from factory which reads env defaults -> strictSchema:false on retry. snippet:
```js
const client = new SDK({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, helperFactory: makeHelper });
await client.callTool('getProfile', payload); // on 401 retry does helper = makeHelper() -> loses strict flag
```

lee-qa: saw a customer case where downstream fncall parse failed because final output was permissive.

sam-sdk: sounds like retry re-instantiation reads process.env defaults in factory. quick mitigation: thread original opts into RetryWrapper so retries reuse strictSchema/jsonMode/schema. low-risk patch.

nina-dx: can we also add a samplekit lint that warns when factories read env for defaults, and an e2e that simulates 401 and asserts final output still fails validation for extra fields?

lee-qa: will add invariant e2e and run with DEFAULT_STRICT true/false to catch env-derived differences.

sam-sdk: I'll open PR: fix to retry, unit tests, samplekit e2e, short docs blurb under SDK helpers about "preserve helper opts across retries". tagging @lee-qa for test signoff.

auth-bot: auth-service: transient 401 spike recorded 2026-04-10T09:12Z.

nina-dx: thanks 10 let's patch sample apps ASAP and add the docs note so DX engineers don't reintroduce this.
